Frontend verified for KitchenPage (Prazo tab delete button, Vendas tab cash balance adjustment) and GestorPage (Gráfico tab store filter dropdown).

context_for_next_testing_agent: All 3 requested features are working: 1) DELETE /api/prazo/debt/{customer_name}?password=1234 clears prazo debt (marks orders as paid with prazo_cleared=True), 2) POST /api/cash/{store}/set-balance sets initial cash balance that persists, 3) GET /api/gestor/chart/daily?store=runner returns filtered daily chart data. Frontend has trash buttons in Prazo tab, pencil button in Vendas tab for cash adjustment, and store filter dropdown in GestorPage Gráfico tab.

delete_prazo_debt_endpoint.details: Clears all unpaid prazo orders for customer by marking them as paid with prazo_cleared=True. Requires password=1234.

set_cash_balance_endpoint.details: Sets initial cash drawer balance. Returns updated drawer status with initial_balance, total_cash_sales, total_withdrawals, current_balance.

daily_chart_store_filter.details: Returns daily chart data filtered by store. Response includes store_filter field indicating which store is selected.

frontend_prazo_delete_button.details: Each debt row has a trash button that triggers handleDeletePrazoDebt function with password prompt.

frontend_cash_balance_adjustment.details: Pencil button opens dialog to adjust initial cash balance. Shows Saldo Inicial, +Vendas, -Retiradas columns.

frontend_chart_store_filter.details: Store filter dropdown appears when 'Dia' view is selected. Options: Todas Lojas, Runner, GYM Londres.
